1: Read the points slowly. Tawḥīd is not a slogan — it is loyalty of the heart.
If a verse is quoted, open it and sit with one line.
You do not need to finish fast. You need to finish sincere.
2: For prayer and purity, use this module as a map — confirm steps with a local teacher.
Mistakes in practice are part of learning when sincerity is present.
Write one small action you will try today.
3: One tajweed rule applied well beats ten rules memorized in haste.
Weekly review is honesty, not self-punishment.
4: Before teaching others, ask: is my source clear?
Adab is part of the message.
If unsure of a ruling, pause and ask qualified scholarship.
